core: T cell immunological synapse formation and polarization
qualifier: adhesion, aggregation and surface signature rather than Vav/Rho GTPase signaling
name: T cell immunological synapse, polarity and adhesion
rationale: All members concern T cell/leukocyte contact formation (rafts, synapse, polarity, adhesion, aggregation, surface markers); unlike the confusables it lacks CD28-Vav1, Rho GTPase and second-messenger signaling and instead carries adhesion and T cell surface signatures.

qualifier: tyrosine and phenylalanine
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All three members are tyrosine or phenylalanine breakdown terms, distinguishing the theme from threonine, glycine and generic amino acid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: Gram-positive attachment and entry into epithelium
name: Gram-positive bacterial adhesion and entry into epithelial cells
rationale: Members cover bacterial attachment to epithelial cells, regulated entry (Listeria InlA), actin-based motility and response to Gram-positive bacteria, unlike confusables centred on antimicrobial peptides, Mtb phagosome manipulation or toxin uptake.

core: Endocrine growth and metabolic hormone signaling
qualifier: thyroid hormone plus GH, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern thyroid hormone action/generation or growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and IGF signaling regulating organism growth, distinguishing it from steroid biosynthesis, IL-6-family cytokine and GH-secretion/somatostatin confusables.

qualifier: establishment in epithelium via asymmetric PCP protein localization
name: Establishment of epithelial planar cell polarity
rationale: All three members concern establishing planar polarity and asymmetric PCP protein localization, without the convergent extension, inner ear or neural plate morphogenesis that define the confusables.

qualifier: SREBP activation and nuclear receptor transcription
name: SREBP- and nuclear receptor-driven cholesterol homeostasis transcription
rationale: Members combine SREBP activation and its promoter motifs, nuclear receptor transcription and positive regulation of cholesterol/vitamin D synthesis, whereas confusables add ChREBP glucose sensing, negative sterol feedback/ER transport, fatty acid response or ATF6.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment plus snRNA/rRNA modification
name: Telomerase recruitment via Cajal bodies and snRNA/rRNA modification
rationale: Members cover telomerase assembly, scaRNA/telomerase localization to Cajal bodies and telomere extension together with snRNA and rRNA modification/processing, lacking the telomere capping/heterochromatin, tRNA methylation, box C/D snoRNP or RNA decay content of the confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation of proliferation and differentiation, outside germinal centre
name: Positive regulation of B cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members describe B cell activation, proliferation, differentiation and B cell signatures with positive regulation; confusables add germinal centre/Tfh/ICOS or negative regulation and BCR signaling cascades.

name: MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Every member is a MET-activated downstream branch (PI3K/AKT, RAS, STAT3, PTPN11, RAP1/RAC1) or its drug inhibition, while confusables are generic PI3K/AKT, ALK/LTK or IGF1R signaling.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic CYP deficiencies
name: Steroid hormone biosynthesis and steroidogenic CYP deficiencies
rationale: Members span pregnenolone, gluco-, mineralo-corticoid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis and the CYP11/17/19/21 defects, distinguishing it from aldosterone/cortisol secretion and vitamin D/retinoic acid CYP confusables.

qualifier: cytokine production and receptor signaling, without Th2/eosinophil/mast cell differentiation
name: IL-4 and IL-13 production and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern IL-4 or IL-13 production or signaling, while confusables are dominated by Th2 differentiation, IL-5, eosinophil and mast cell terms.

qualifier: glucose-6-phosphate handling and glycogen storage diseases
name: Glycogen metabolism, glucose-6-phosphate handling and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown, glycophagy and storage diseases plus glucokinase, PGM1 and G6P transport/hydrolysis defects, unlike confusables centred on glycolysis, fructose and gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: skeletal myogenesis, satellite cell regeneration and calcineurin-driven adaptive growth
name: Striated muscle myogenesis, regeneration, contraction and adaptive growth
rationale: Most members concern skeletal and cardiac muscle cell differentiation, fusion, regeneration, hypertrophy/atrophy, contraction and calcineurin-NFAT signaling, whereas confusables focus on heart morphogenesis, vascular smooth muscle or phosphatase/calcium signaling.

qualifier: fermentation to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
name: Glucose glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Members cover hexokinase-initiated glucose catabolism, fructose bisphosphate metabolism and lactate fermentation, distinguishing the theme from glycogen/glucagon, gluconeogenesis and pentose-phosphate regulation confusables.

qualifier: inhibitory KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: NK cell regulation by KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members centre on NK receptor (KIR) clusters, MHC class Ib presentation, protection from and negative regulation of NK/T cytotoxicity, whereas confusables carry positive cytotoxicity regulation or T cell costimulation and dendritic cell terms.

qualifier: apoptotic cell recognition and clearance
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members combine microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and migration with phosphatidylserine-dependent apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, unlike confusables centred on amyloid-beta clearance, DAP12 or scavenger receptors.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
qualifier: MTF1 metal-responsive transcription
name: ROS detoxification with MTF1 metal-responsive transcription
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, HMOX1, redox homeostasis and reduced oxidoreductase activity together with MTF1 gene activation, which separates it from the BACH1/peroxide confusable, the metallothionein metal-response one and nitrosative stress ones.

qualifier: glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Organic acid metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are broad amino/organic acid metabolic terms plus mitochondrial conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with glycine or glutamine, which the proline, glycine and threonine confusables lack.

qualifier: centrosome maturation and astral microtubule orientation
name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover recruitment of centrosome proteins/NuMA, AURKA-TPX2 activation, astral microtubules and spindle localization/orientation, distinct from APC/C mitotic progression, centriole/cilia and chromosome segregation confusables.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
qualifier: peroxide and superoxide removal with BACH1-HMOX1 regulation
name: Peroxide and superoxide detoxification with BACH1-HMOX1 regulation
rationale: Members cover hydrogen peroxide catabolism, superoxide removal, selenium and oxygen sensing, BACH1 and HMOX1 control of redox homeostasis, lacking the nitrosative/peroxide response and MTF1 terms of the confusables.
Members mix generic protein homo/hetero-oligomerization terms with magnesium transport, the NLRP1 inflammasome and ER multi-pass membrane protein insertion, sharing no single biological process.

qualifier: proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity without apoptotic cell or amyloid clearance
name: Microglial cell activation, proliferation and migration
rationale: All members describe microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and lysosome regulation, without the apoptotic cell clearance, amyloid-beta or DAP12 terms of the confusables.

qualifier: C-type lectin (Dectin) receptors and IL-23 production
name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal innate immunity
rationale: Members concern fungal recognition via Dectin-1/Dectin-2 family lectins, antifungal innate response and IL-23 production, unlike confusables on IL-17/IL-1 family signaling or Th1/IL-12 responses.

qualifier: promoter-proximal pausing and early elongation, including HIV Tat
name: RNA polymerase II pausing and early elongation, including HIV Tat
rationale: Members cover Pol II early elongation complex formation, pausing/arrest and recovery, CTD phosphorylation and their HIV Tat-dependent counterparts, whereas confusables centre on initiation, promoter escape and capping.

core: Vitamin and vitamin-like nutrient metabolism and transport
qualifier: choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin with FMO oxidation
name: Choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover choline catabolism and FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, carnitine synthesis/transport, and vitamin B1 and B2 metabolism/transport, without the fatty acid oxidation, cobalamin/biotin, sulfur or folate content of the confusables.
